what_it_is.prose: BrahMos Aerospace is the Indo-Russian JV that designs, develops, produces and markets the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile — globally the fastest operational cruise missile (Mach 2.8-3). The missile can be launched from land, ship, submarine, and air (Su-30MKI ALCM). Production is centred at Hyderabad with a new Lucknow facility increasing total output by 20% (Jun 2026). The Indian Navy placed a ₹19,000 Cr order for 200+ extended-range missiles in Feb 2024. BrahMos is also India's flagship defence-export product: $375M Philippine Shore-Based Anti-Ship Missile System contract (2022, deliveries 2024); Vietnam deal ~$700M (Dec 2024); Indonesia agreement signed (Jul 2026); UAE in talks. Next-generation BrahMos-NG (1.2 t, Mach 5, 290 km range) and 1,500-km long-range variant in development (announced Jun 2026).

rows.india_status: Operational across Indian Army (regiment-level launchers), Indian Navy (over 10 ship classes), and Indian Air Force (Su-30MKI ALCM). Speed Mach 2.8-3, range 290 km (export) / 450-500 km (domestic), reported test range up to 800 km
Smaller (1.2-1.3 t vs 3 t original), faster (Mach 5), 290 km range, multi-platform launchable including from any fighter aircraft. Joint development with DRDO; announced 2026
